international.title: Trump says pardon for Nvidia boss Huang ‘always an option’ after accusations of breaking export laws – US politics live
international.summary: The US president urged the tech leader to ‘tell the truth’ in upcoming testimony in a Senate hearing Sign up for the Breaking News US email to get newsletter alerts in your inbox The Trump administration is planning to hike tariffs on Chinese goods by an additional 20% and raise import taxes on products from the European Union , Japan , South Korea , Taiwan and nine other major trading partners , with Donald Trump seemingly undeterred by his resounding midterms defeat, in which his handling of the economy was a major factor, and a large cohort of his previous levies being struck down by the supreme court. The US Trade Representative’s office announced the tariffs after completing an eight-month Section 301 unfair trade practices probe into 16 trading partners, including Bangladesh , ‌ Cambodia , India , Indonesia , Malaysia , Singapore , Switzerland , Thailand and Vietnam . For now, Mexico and Norway have pending investigations and are excluded from new levies. Continue reading...
